intro.title: I’m Immanuel. I design and build things, and I start by listening.
intro.lead: First-year CS and Math student at Livingstone College, class of 2030. I like hard problems and long tables full of friends.
intro.photoCaption: Picnics are my favorite kind of meeting.

story.title: My story
paragraphs: I came to Livingstone College to study Computer Science and Math, and I am grateful to be here as an LC Presidential Scholar. I am in my first year, class of 2030.

Before I cared about pixels, I cared about people. I am the friend who stays up talking someone through a hard week, the one who organizes the study session before the exam, and the one who asks the group chat, "picnic on Saturday?" Listening comes first for me, with friends and in design.

That habit turned into how I build. I took CodePath Web 101 to learn the web properly, I go to hackathons to ship with a team under pressure, and as a ColorStack Campus Advocate I help other CS students find resources and community.

I call myself a designer who engineers. I love starting in Figma, but I do not want to hand off a picture and walk away. I want to understand the constraints, write the code, and make sure what ships is what people actually needed.

items.title: Listen before I design
items.text: I talk with the people involved first. The best ideas I have had came from someone describing a bad day, not from a blank canvas.

items.title: Design the awkward moments
items.text: Errors, empty states, full events, and failed checks. If a product is honest when things go wrong, people trust it when things go right.

items.title: Make it real
items.text: A design is a guess until it runs. I build in code early, so the hard parts show up while they are still cheap to fix.

items.title: Say what is done and what is not
items.text: I label sample data as sample data and concepts as concepts. Being clear about status is part of the work.

away.title: Away from the screen
away.lead: Most of what I know about people I learned around a table, so I keep setting one.
